reviews.comment: Great professor! Informative lectures, questions keep the class engaged. Very approachable and caring. Not a lot of points to go around, but the exams are easy and the two or three projects are actually fun. Easy class where you can learn alot.

reviews.comment: Very fun class. Sometimes, the amount of readings were a bit much (60-80 pages of textbook a week), but the content is so interesting. I like the way she teaches the content and she clearly has a passion for it.

reviews.comment: Super easy class, barely any work, zero homework/outside readings that are actually required. If you genuinely want to learn, by all means do all the work, but literally none of it is necessary. Easiest class ever.

Best teacher I have ever had.  She is so sweet and great at teaching. No tests just a few quizzes, discussion posts and a final paper. She is very clear on her grading and rubrics and wants you to succeed! Great option for a Lit credit. TAKE HER!!

reviews.comment: Dr. T is one of the kindest most genuine profs I have ever had. You definitely have a lot to read here, and the quizzes require tedious studying as does the final.
